prompts.prompt-r1.txt: Photorealistic original artistic interpretation (not a photograph) of the Tower of Hercules in A Coruña, Galicia, Spain AT NIGHT. Tourist viewpoint: the coastal path, looking at the lighthouse. Frame: the Tower of Hercules, the ancient Roman lighthouse on the rocky peninsula; the Atlantic breaking on the rocks around the peninsula; the sea beyond the tower. Light and weather: clear night, light breeze — the lighthouse softly lit with a rotating beacon beam, moonlit rocks and surf, no invented lighting beyond the beacon, no daylight anywhere. Main subject centered to survive a 4:5 center crop. No identifiable people, no legible logos, no text, lettering or signs anywhere in the image. Keep the lower third clean and uncluttered.
